# Sparkline

The product's only chart form — a neon line over an 8%-opacity area fill.

`SuDuAI.Sparkline` · Data

## Use

```jsx
<SuDuAI.Sparkline />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SuDuAI.Sparkline"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Trend chart for latency/throughput profiles inside a diagnostic card.

## Props (SparklineProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `points` | `number[]` | Series values, oldest first. |
| `threshold` | `number` | Draws a dashed threshold rule at this value. |
| `height` | `number` | Rendered height in px. Default 96. |
| `color` | `string` | Line and area color. Default --primary-container. |
| `thresholdColor` | `string` | Threshold rule color. Default --error. |
| `markPeak` | `boolean` | Marks the series maximum with a neon dot. Default true. |
